main.description: A thought's current public state. The record key is the thought's stable local id, so identity survives releases and prose references resolve unchanged. Publication attests the author's deliberate inclusion; status expresses their stance — it does not certify truth or careful review.

source.description: Evidence only: citation, URL, or dataset.

currentRevision.description: The com.disnetdev.trellis.revision record holding this exact content.

confidence.description: Calibrated confidence on a prediction: a probability, or a low/high interval in `unit`, optionally resolvable by a date. Numeric values are decimal strings because the atproto data model has no float type.
